title: wy_not_pics
summary: A client photography portfolio with masonry galleries, pricing, and inquiry paths.
tagline: A photography website for Wyatt Bullock (@wy_not_pics) that moves his sports, portrait, and lifestyle work out of a square-cropped social feed and gives clients a clear path to book.
role: Designed and built the website. The photography is Wyatt Bullock's.
problem: Wyatt's photography was strong, but it lived in a social feed: square crops inside someone else's interface, with no simple way for a prospective client to see packages or book a shoot.
contribution: I designed and built the site for Wyatt: its structure, visual system, galleries, pricing and contact pages, and an update workflow that lets new work drop in without a redesign.
solution: Portfolio sections for sports, portraits, and lifestyle use a masonry grid that keeps each photo's real proportions, with a full-screen lightbox. A pricing page lays out session packages, and every page leads to direct email and the Instagram handle the brand grew from.
solutionPoints: Home, portfolio with three collections, about, pricing, and contact.
Deep ink-blue surfaces, ivory text, cyan and amber accents, and a film-grain texture.
Masonry gallery, lightbox, portfolio sub-tabs, and page transitions.
Galleries and pricing that update without layout changes.

architecture.summary: Collections and packages are data; the layout stays fixed.

decisions.title: Every photo keeps its composition.
decisions.text: Portrait and landscape frames are shown at their real proportions instead of square crops.

decisions.title: A real page for every collection.
decisions.text: Each portfolio section has its own address, and older links keep working.

decisions.title: Updates without redesigns.
decisions.text: New shoots and packages drop into place without touching the layout.

outcomes: The site gives Wyatt an owned, browsable home for his work with a direct inquiry path.
limits: All photographs on the site are Wyatt Bullock's. Booking or revenue results are not claimed.
lessons: An owned photography site can preserve image composition while giving prospective clients a clear next step.
assistantNote: wy_not_pics is Wyatt Bullock's photography brand. It is unrelated to the Y NOT? streetwear label (ynot.lifestyle).
